projects.name: Banking Transformation covering Customer Onboarding, Payments, CASA, Deposits, Corporate
details: Lending, Account Servicing, KYC/AML Compliance, and Core Banking (Flexcube) integration across Net Banking
and Mobile Banking platforms.
• Gathered, analyzed, and documented business requirements through BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Acceptance
Criteria, and Process Flows.
• Led requirement analysis and solution design for Payments, Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, CASA,
Deposits, Account Servicing, and Corporate Lending journeys.
• Worked on Domestic Payments (UPI, NEFT, RTGS, IMPS), payment processing, reconciliation, transaction
lifecycle management, and customer servicing workflows.
• Supported Cross-Border Payments, SWIFT MT, and ISO 20022 readiness initiatives as part of payment
modernization programs.
• Conducted AS-IS / TO-BE analysis, Gap Analysis, process optimization, and digital transformation initiatives.
• Collaborated with Business, Operations, Credit, Risk, Compliance, Product, and Technology teams to deliver
banking and payments solutions.
• Supported Corporate Lending processes including customer onboarding, credit assessment, loan origination,
disbursement, servicing, and collections journeys.
• Facilitated stakeholder workshops, backlog refinement, requirement walkthroughs, and business sign-offs in
Agile delivery environments.
• Supported UAT planning, test case reviews, defect management, release validation, and production
readiness activities.
• Coordinated integrations across Flexcube, Payments, KYC/AML, CRM, APIs, and third-party banking systems.
2) Aarav Global Products & Services Pvt Ltd. Client: Bank of Baroda - Feb 2024 to June 2024.

projects.name: Banking Transformation program focused on Payments, Transaction Banking, Retail Banking,
details: Corporate Banking, CASA, Deposits, Cards, Retail & Corporate Lending, Account Servicing, KYC/AML Compliance,
and Core Banking (Finacle) integration across Net Banking and Mobile Banking channels.
• Led requirement gathering and implementation for Digital Banking, Payments, Retail Banking, Corporate
Banking, CASA, Deposits, Cards, Lending, and Account Servicing initiatives across Net Banking and Mobile
Banking platforms.
• Supported Cross-Border Payments, SWIFT MT, and ISO 20022 readiness initiatives as part of payment
modernization programs.
• Worked on Payments and Transaction Banking journeys including fund transfers, beneficiary management,
payment processing, digital channels, and customer servicing workflows.
• Gathered and documented business requirements for Retail Lending and Corporate Lending products across
Loan Origination System (LOS).
• Supported loan onboarding, credit assessment, loan processing, sanction, disbursement, servicing, and
collections journeys.
• Collaborated with Business, Credit, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and Technology teams to deliver process
transformation and digital banking initiatives.
• Conducted Gap Analysis (AS-IS / TO-BE), process optimization, and automation initiatives across payments,
lending, and account servicing functions.
• Prepared BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Process Flows, Acceptance Criteria, and Functional Specifications.
• Supported integrations with Core Banking (Finacle), Payments, KYC/AML, CRM, and third-party systems.
• Coordinated UAT, defect management, business validation, and production deployments to ensure successful
implementation.
Previous Work Experience:
• Deputy Branch Manager, Retail Banking at IndusInd Bank during Sep-18 & Mar-19 at Nagpur.
• Deputy Branch Manager, Retail Banking at ICICI Bank during May-16 & Aug-18 at Nagpur.
• Assistant Branch Manager, Retail Banking at HDFC Bank during July-15 & May-16 at Nagpur.
